title: Close-range C-C pair at rest, separation 2.0: first C-C data below r = 3
pitch: All C-C data so far is at separation 5 (P-0005, 4 values, plus the B-C-C triangle). Close-CC is an open bounty and H9 (coupling factorisation) is unresolved for C-C. Pre-registered prediction: power law K = 12.36, P = 2.5 predicts separation 1.37 at t = 0.5 (analysis/pred_2026-11-20_CC_r2_grant.json, written before any result). One pair, 1000 samples, tracker and census. Cost 1.02 of the 120-credit award.
